descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S07 「超过四段转写折进 Earlier sessions，每块三段，行数相加」 More than four sessions fold into 'Earlier sessions' chunks of three, with summed line counts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Functionality and design match the p72 prototype's TranscriptHistory: row style, line-count chip, chevron, one open at a time, and longer lists folded into 'Earlier sessions'.（TFA-92594 AC 1）
  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 AC 3；TFA-92594 How it works 3）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Tim's chromium test: five '(prior)' sessions (Sep 19-23, 1 or 2 lines each) and no current transcript

When Open the Encounter tab; open the first chunk, then the second

Then Two 'Earlier sessions' rows ('4 lines', '3 lines'); an open chunk shows each session under its own label; one chunk open at a time

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions: groups toHaveCount(2), toContainText '4 lines' / '3 lines' (U3 summed count), per-session labels visible only inside the open chunk, aria-expanded (T1: prototype :6697-6710). The test seeds five days with no archivedAt and asserts all five are listed: it supports the T1 grouping only and shows the U6a risk; it is not evidence for U6. …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-16/S07
